title: Fix what loses visitors on the pricing and sign-up pages
description:
Find and fix what loses visitors on the pricing and sign-up pages, documented as a page-by-page table.

Deliverables in the attachment:
1. A page-by-page table for /pricing, /auth/sign-up and /auth/login: URL, what is on the page now, the exact change, and what it costs the visitor. Cover the plan name mismatch (Starter/Pro/Enterprise in cards vs Starter/Growth/Enterprise in the table), the "Start Pro Plan" button pointing at an app route, the bare "Zedu" titles and missing meta descriptions, the image-based comparison marks, and the repeated FAQ block.
2. The same three pages re-checked at phone size, with a screenshot or written description of each problem.
3. A short list of the fixes ranked by effort and impact.

Rules: every URL, title, description and figure comes from a live fetch on the delivery date, recorded with the date and HTTP status; no page is assumed to exist because it appears in the navigation. Deliver as a document. Do not change any code. 80 points because this covers three pages with per-element evidence and phone-size re-checks, not a single fix.

goal.title: Find and fix what loses visitors on the pricing and sign-up pages, by Fri 13 Nov
goal.description: People who reach the pricing and sign-up pages are the closest to signing up, so every point where they stop matters. Work under this goal: walk through the live pricing page and the sign-up flow as a new educator on a phone and on a laptop; list every point that is unclear, broken or slow (unclear plan names, missing price units, confusing buttons, form errors, extra steps); and write the exact fix for each, ranked by how many visitors it likely affects. Use only what is on the live site, and say plainly what could not be tested without an account. This is separate from the French translation and the speed goals. Done when a ranked list with exact copy or layout changes is delivered and approved by the team.

workstream.title: The pricing and sign-up problems I can already see on the live pages
workstream.description:
I fetched /pricing and /auth/sign-up on 22 October 2026. These are the specific things a visitor runs into, each one checkable by anyone who opens the page.

1. The plan names disagree with themselves. The three plan cards read Starter, Pro and Enterprise. The comparison table on the same page heads its columns Starter, Growth and Enterprise. A visitor comparing the cards to the table sees a plan that does not exist on the page. Fix: one name per plan in the cards, the table and the page copy.

2. The "Start Pro Plan" button on /pricing and on the home page points to /client/settings/organisation/billing/all-plans, which is an app route rather than a marketing page. A visitor who clicks it to see the Pro plan leaves the marketing site for a signed-out app URL. Fix: point it at the Pro section of the pricing page, or at /auth/sign-up.

3. /auth/sign-up and /auth/login both serve the title "Zedu" and no meta description. Anyone arriving from search or a shared link sees a bare title. Fix: a title and description that say what the page does.

4. The per-plan marks in the comparison table are images. The markup does carry aria-label="Included" on the mark, so a screen reader gets the answer, but the page as served as plain text contains the feature names without the words included or not included. Fix: keep the visible mark and put the word in the accessible text so crawlers and plain-text readers see it too.

5. The same "Got a Question? We Have an Answer" block appears on the home page, on /pricing and on all three product pages, so a pricing visitor's questions are answered by a block that also appears on five other pages.

Deliverable: a page-by-page table (URL, what is on the page now, the exact change, what it costs the visitor) for /pricing, /auth/sign-up and /auth/login, then the same three pages re-checked at phone size with a screenshot of each problem.
